what: Paired measurement of the one optimisation that mattered in the shell kernel: extracting an ABI field by assignment (`fld` sets a variable) against by command substitution (`x=$(fld ...)`), which forks a subshell per field. Both variants pass all 350 conformance cases with zero cross-kernel trace disagreements, so this is the same kernel measured twice, not two kernels.
why_separate: Kept out of systems/results.json on purpose. The forking variant is not one of the four kernels and must not enter the throughput spread or the slowest-kernel figures.
